item.title: I used to eat raw ground beef and it tasted great
item.description: "My mother, her sister, and I used to eat raw ground beef and we would put chop up onions in it and use garlic, salt, and pepper and it was really great! But I don't do that anymore, but I will tell you one thing: It tasted great!" - A Marion County resident shares his opinion in light of an episode of TLC's "My Strange Addiction" featuring an Ocala woman. Read more: I used to eat raw ground beef and it tasted great

item.title: I am not in support of the new water park in Marion County
item.description: "In my opinion, this project should not be done. Orange Lake, as it is now, is one of the few remaining lovely pieces of nature in the county. Marion County is already turning into Orlando North, which is not good. Citra is a cute little town which will be ruined by the traffic and congestion. Silver Springs and Wild Waters did not survive, and I am afraid that Citra will be left with another eyesore on the landscape." - An Ocala resident shares her opinion about the new Camp Margaritaville Reso

item.title: I believe Ocala, Marion County, and the state are overspending
item.description: "One million dollars for a skate park? A quarter of a million dollars for time clocks? Millions of dollars for new fleet of county/city cars? Half a million dollars for new golf carts? All the while, the SW 66th Street overpass is still one lane 7 or 8 months later. It's no longer about our community but about the palms that are being greased by the big monies that have found their way into our community and it's no longer for the people of the community.
